description: Review agent cases (Orbit Agents spec §6/§11): drafts for one X slot of a confirmed assignment in the synthetic package project (fact beta.access = 'open for product teams', CTA 'Learn more.', voice 'clear'). 'recorded' is the model answer replayed offline (written for this set, not captured from a live model); deterministic cases deliberately record a wrong 'approve' to prove the model cannot clear a blocker. A bad case is never approved: it is rejected, or (expected verdict 'owner') left unjudged for the owner when the check cannot tell a link from a name, such as a bare host. The live run against the configured model needs Mario's cost approval before agent approval goes live.
